import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

arr7 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0007.png').convert('RGB'))
col = 256
ceil_y = np.where(arr7[:, col, 0] < 50)[0][-1]
floor_y = np.where((arr7[:, col, 0] > 100) & (arr7[:, col, 0] < 200))[0][0]
print(f'obs7 col 256: ceil_y={ceil_y}, floor_y={floor_y}')

# In obs1: ceil_y was 210, floor_y was 304 (diff = 94 pixels)
# In obs7: ceil_y and floor_y:
# d_7 = 256 * 1.55 / (floor_y - 255.5)
print('Distance in obs7:', 256 * 1.55 / (floor_y - 255.5))
print('Delta distance:', 256 * 1.55 / (304 - 255.5) - 256 * 1.55 / (floor_y - 255.5))
"
